title: aristolochia cymbifera var. labiosa
intro: Aristolochia cymbifera var. labiosa, commonly known as Chinese birthwort, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Aristolochiaceae family. It is traditionally used in medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chinese birthwort include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and relieve respiratory congestion, making it a valuable remedy in traditional Chinese medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include aristolochic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although they can also be toxic in high doses.
